description: This file provides functions for extracting and processing text from resume document files such as PDF and DOCX, as well as heuristics for parsing structured information like names, emails, phone numbers, and skills from resume text.

methods.name: str _clean_text(text: str)
methods.description: Cleans the input text by removing null characters, normalizing whitespace, and reducing multiple newlines.

methods.name: str extract_text_from_pdf(data: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from a PDF byte stream, handling exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: str extract_text_from_docx(data: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from a DOCX byte stream by iterating through paragraphs.

methods.name: str extract_text(filename: str, content_type: Optional[str], data: bytes)
methods.description: Determines the document type and invokes the appropriate extraction method; falls back to UTF-8 text decoding.

methods.name: List[str] _find_emails(text: str)
methods.description: Finds email addresses in the text using regex.

methods.name: Optional[str] _find_phone(text: str)
methods.description: Finds a phone number in the text using regex.

methods.name: Optional[str] _guess_name(text: str)
methods.description: Naively attempts to extract a name from the text based on capitalization and line structure.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] extract_structured_fields(raw_text: str)
methods.description: Extracts structured data such as name, emails, phone, and skills from raw resume text.

ctags.name: extract_text
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_text(filename: str, content_type: Optional[str], data: bytes) -> str:$/
